baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated sequence جاء ربك والملك صفا صفا joins active arrival, titled authority, the collective angel, and a doubled row construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Arrival or occurrence joins lordship to the literal angel branch, while the repeated straight-row image turns sovereignty into a visible, serially ordered presence.

activation_trace.role: Supplies concrete or abstract arrival and makes the coming the eventive hinge of the scene.
Supplies lordship, ownership, and obeyed authority, so the arriver is sovereign rather than another member of the procession.
Supplies the literal angel branch and identifies the collective attendant host.
Supplies straight, level ranks; the doubled occurrence spatializes disciplined order row after row.

changed_reading.before: Your Lord comes while the angels stand in rows.
changed_reading.after: A sovereign advent becomes publicly legible through an angelic array whose repeated ranks enact, rather than merely decorate, authority.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ربك can carry staged repair and nurture, while الملك and صفا صفا can carry cohesion, mainstay, and ordered support.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord's coming can be the completion of a long administration: staged nurture reaches its terminus in a cohesive angelic order that supports the completed arrangement.

activation_trace.role: Allows the coming to be an abstract occurrence or achieved arrival, supplying the culminating event.
Supplies repair, nurture, administration, and stage-by-stage completion as the process that now reaches visibility.
Supplies strength and cohesion, making the angelic host an integrated body rather than a crowd.
Supplies the mainstay on which a matter stands and gives the host a supporting function in the completed order.
Supplies the repeated straight ranks through which cohesion and support become spatially explicit.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports an imposing arrival and an attendant host.
changed_reading.after: The verse can also mark the completion of sustained lordly care, with a cohesive angelic array serving as the mainstay of the order now brought to completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb جاء is intransitive, but its packet inventory also preserves bringing, presenting, and causative compulsion branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: Without replacing the surface arrival, the collateral branches add a secondary pressure: the sovereign advent is the moment at which beings and matters can no longer remain absent but are brought into ordered presence.

activation_trace.role: Supplies bringing or presenting something and gives the arrival a collateral presentation horizon.
Supplies the form-distant image of driving or compelling, retained as pressure toward unavoidable presence rather than a direct gloss.
Supplies sovereign authority as the source of the unavoidable presentation.
Supplies the angelic host as the visible attendants of the presentation.
Supplies ordered placement after presentation, with every presence assigned to a rank.

changed_reading.before: The subject arrives at an already assembled scene.
changed_reading.after: The advent also casts an exploratory horizon of compulsory disclosure: arrival and the forced ordering of all presences become one event.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled صفا is anchored both in the ordinary row branch and in the collateral صفصف image of smooth, bare, level ground.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repetition can project two geometries at once: ranks aligned across the scene and a uniformly leveled field on which no elevation interrupts the array.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the surface-near straight ranks that occupy the scene.
Supplies the branch-distant level, smooth, bare ground and lets the repeated rows imply a leveled horizon.
Locates the double geometry at the moment the advent occurs.

changed_reading.before: The angels stand in successive rows.
changed_reading.after: The doubled row expression can simultaneously evoke an array and the level field that makes every rank fully exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prologue moves through darkness, nocturnal motion, dawn rupture, and uncovering. That sequence turns the focus arrival from motion inside a visible scene into the event by which the scene and its ranks become visible.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the arrival or occurrence that is revised into an emergence from concealment.
Supplies the ranks that become successively legible when the concealed scene opens.
Supplies dawn breaking out of night and functions as the temporal image for the advent's disclosure.
Supplies nocturnal darkness as the prior state from which the focus scene emerges.
Supplies uncovering and dispersal of what covered, turning the night's movement into a transition toward revelation.

structural_cues: Ayat 89:1-4 sequence dawn, counted nights, and a night in motion before the focus advent.
The focus conjunctions then expose authority and host together rather than revealing them in separate scenes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dawn rupture, darkness, nocturnal movement, and uncovering; I supply the arrow that their order frames جاء as disclosure. A live alternative is that the oath images remain independent signs with no temporal causation into 89:22.

changed_reading.before: A procession enters a scene that is already open to view.
changed_reading.after: The advent is the breaking of concealment itself: authority and its rows come into visibility as the traversed night opens.

context_deltas.mechanism: Counting by tens, joining pairs, preserving the unpaired, dividing shares, and enclosing boundaries make صفا صفا a distributive operation. The host is not an undifferentiated multitude but a total assembled through bounded units.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the repeated rank as the focus unit that can be counted, bounded, and distributed.
Supplies the literal pattern 'ten by ten' and makes doubled unit nouns available as distributive counting rather than mere emphasis.
Supplies joining one thing to its like and gives paired units a constructive place in the array.
Supplies the single without a pair and preserves irreducible units inside the ordered total.
Supplies an extended strip or row and spatially links the even-odd contrast to the focus ranks.
Supplies division into assigned shares and functions as the sorting rule behind distinct ranks.
Supplies prevention and enclosure, giving each distributed rank a boundary that keeps order from collapsing back into a mass.

structural_cues: The oath sequence counts ten, sets even beside odd, and then names an oath and a restraining faculty.
صفا صفا repeats a unit noun in a form that can answer the packet's عشرة عشرة branch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies counting, pairing, singularity, division, and enclosure; I supply the arrow that these become an assembly algorithm for the doubled صف. A live alternative is that each oath object is symbolic on its own and the focus repetition simply means many rows.

changed_reading.before: The angels form a large homogeneous set of rows.
changed_reading.after: The host is a counted and partitioned total, row by row, in which paired and unpaired units remain distinct inside a bounded order.

context_deltas.mechanism: An opening oath, the covenant branch latent in رب, and the later confirmed bond form a covenantal frame. Within it, the advent and rows can be read as an assize where a binding relation is publicly witnessed and enforced.

activation_trace.role: Supplies covenant, pledge, and protected relation as a latent function of the focus Lord-title.
Supplies the public ranks that can function as witnesses and executors of the binding relation.
Supplies an oath apportioned to its people and opens the possible covenantal frame.
Reactivates the covenant branch at the watching Lord and links observation to accountability under a bond.
Supplies a confirmed covenant or pledge and closes the frame with binding force.

structural_cues: The surah opens with sworn objects and later repeats verb-plus-cognate binding language.
The focus occupies the interval between moral breach and unmatched enforcement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oath, covenant, and confirmed bond; I supply the arrow that the focus rows witness a covenantal assize. A live alternative is that قسم is only rhetorical oath and وثاق only physical restraint, with no shared legal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The rows furnish a royal court.
changed_reading.after: The court can also be a covenant assize: the Lord's advent publicly brings a binding relation to witness and enforcement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier command to see how the same Lord acted prevents the focus coming from being the start of agency. It is better carried as the public occurrence or disclosure of an agency already active in history, testing, punishment, and watch.

activation_trace.role: Supplies abstract as well as concrete occurrence, allowing advent to mean manifested event rather than the beginning of action.
Keeps the focus anchored in the same sovereign Lord whose action the context has already displayed.
Supplies showing and making visible, so prior lordly action becomes evidence for how the focus advent is perceived.
Supplies the production of an act and establishes that the Lord's efficacy precedes the focus scene.
Identifies the historical actor with the sovereign named in the focus and carries continuity of agency.

structural_cues: The branchless ك ي ف at 89:6 supplies an interrogative structural frame only; no mapped root or branch is assigned to it.
ربك recurs as actor at 89:6 and 89:13 and as watcher at 89:14 before appearing as the focus subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior visible action by the same Lord and an arrival branch broad enough for abstract occurrence; I supply the arrow that 89:22 manifests already operative agency. A live alternative is that the final advent remains a wholly distinct event after the historical examples.

changed_reading.before: The Lord begins the decisive action by coming.
changed_reading.after: The coming is the public manifestation and culmination of an agency that has already acted, tested, punished, and watched.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pillars, penetrated rock, and fixed stakes build a vertical material grammar of human permanence. The focus answers with a living horizontal architecture: the true mainstay is an angelic host ordered in rows after monumental supports prove unable to hold.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the mainstay on which a matter depends and lets the angelic host replace failed monumental supports.
Supplies the horizontal living lines that become the focus scene's counter-architecture.
Supplies physical support by a pillar and establishes the monumental architecture to be answered.
Supplies penetrating cutting and makes the rock architecture an engineered claim to permanence.
Supplies massive solid rock as the resistant material of the failed human order.
Supplies upright fixity like a stake and completes the context's vertical stability claim.

structural_cues: Ayat 89:7-10 catalogue pillars, unprecedented construction, cut rock, and stakes before their owners' overthrow.
The focus replaces named imperial builders with a collective host whose order is relational rather than monumental.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human supports, cut stone, stakes, and the focus mainstay and row branches; I supply the replacement arrow from failed monument to living order. A live alternative is that the historical architecture only magnifies past power and does not describe the focus host.

changed_reading.before: The angelic rows are ceremonial attendants.
changed_reading.after: The rows are a counter-architecture: a living, divinely sustained order succeeds the pillars, rock, and stakes that could not secure human dominion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Unbounded rise and multiplication leave balance, then punishment is poured as a mixed striking measure, watched, and finally bound. The focus rows become the containing lattice that converts runaway excess into inspected and enforceable order.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the authority that imposes a limit on the context's unbounded excess.
Supplies cohesion and strength, giving the angelic host the consistency of a retaining body.
Supplies straight ranks as the spatial lattice that contains and sorts what had exceeded measure.
Supplies rising water and sweeping force as the context's image of excess escaping its limit.
Supplies numerical growth and makes corruption an accumulating pressure rather than an isolated act.
Supplies departure from soundness and balance, naming the disorder that the focus array reverses.
Supplies pouring and downward flow, converting diffuse excess into a directed counterflow.
Supplies mixing one thing with another and makes the punitive measure compounded rather than singular.
Supplies the literal whip and gives the compounded measure an enforcing edge.
Supplies painful punishment as the consequence carried by the poured measure.
Supplies watchfulness and guarding, turning the ordered scene into continuous inspection.
Supplies the bond that physically secures, extending the containing function of the rows into final restraint.

structural_cues: Ayat 89:11-14 move causally from transgression to multiplied corruption, poured punishment, and a watching position.
Ayat 89:25-26 close the sequence with unmatched punishment and binding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overflow, accumulation, loss of balance, directed pouring, watch, and binding; I supply the arrow that the angelic rows form their containing lattice. A live alternative is that the rows are honor guards and the flow images describe punishment without any spatial containment role.

changed_reading.after: The rows are also an enforcement perimeter: runaway excess is arrested, inspected, sorted, and held within sovereign order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context corrects the equation of wealth with honor and exposes possession without care: the orphan lacks a guardian, the poor is not fed, inherited property is consumed, and wealth is accumulated. Focus رب and ملك then separate true ownership from acquisitive control by joining authority to nurture, foster-care, and an angelic administration.

activation_trace.role: Supplies ownership and mastery as the authority whose meaning the social context tests.
Supplies nurture, repair, and administration, defining true lordship by sustained care rather than possession alone.
Supplies the fostered child and caregiver relation, directly activating against the context's abandoned orphan.
Supplies property and delegated disposal, making ownership a latent issue inside the angel root.
Keeps the surface reference angelic and lets the host embody administration under true ownership.
Supplies testing that reveals a condition, so abundance and restriction expose rather than determine human worth.
Supplies honorable generosity and relocates honor from being wealthy to acting generously.
Supplies a child cut off from a guardian and activates the caregiver branch latent in رب.
Supplies feeding another and makes material provision the practical test of care.
Supplies consuming or taking wealth and exposes disposal severed from responsibility.
Supplies transfer from predecessor to heir and makes human holding visibly derivative rather than absolute.
Supplies acquiring and multiplying wealth as the possessive pattern judged by the advent.

structural_cues: كلا بل at 89:17 explicitly corrects the human readings of honor and humiliation in 89:15-16.
The pronoun shifts from the self-interested ربي claims to ربك in the focus and ربكِ in the final address.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, failed guardianship, refused feeding, derivative inheritance, acquisitive wealth, and focus branches of ownership and care; I supply the arrow that the advent audits possession by the standard of nurture. A live alternative is that the social indictment and angelic advent are adjacent consequences without an ownership mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The Lord arrives as owner and the angels attend.
changed_reading.after: True sovereignty arrives to expose ownership without care as counterfeit; the angelic host manifests administration in which authority, provision, and guardianship remain joined.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first gathers property into an indiscriminate consumptive heap and fills desire to excess; the earth is then crushed and leveled; the focus finally reassembles multiplicity as discrete ranks. صفا صفا is the ordered counterform to لما and جما.

activation_trace.role: Supplies discrete straight rows as the ordered form that replaces indiscriminate accumulation.
Supplies consuming and taking wealth as the force that converts inheritance into an undifferentiated possession.
Supplies gathering scattered things into one mass and gives the pre-focus disorder its heap form.
Supplies love fixed in the heart and makes accumulation affectively self-reinforcing.
Supplies abundance gathered to fullness and intensifies the heap immediately before its destruction.
Supplies pounding and demolition to levelness, the destructive middle operation between heap and array.

structural_cues: The sequence أكلا لما, حبا جما, دكا دكا, صفا صفا moves from two intensive accumulations to two doubled re-formations.
The immediate transition from the repeated دكا to repeated صفا makes material transformation more than a broad thematic link.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathered consumption, full accumulation, crushing, and straight ranks; I supply the arrow that crushing de-accumulates the heap and rows recompose multiplicity under measure. A live alternative is that the four sound patterns only intensify separate clauses.

changed_reading.before: The angelic rows simply follow the crushing of the earth.
changed_reading.after: The rows are the positive form produced after acquisitive heaps and their ground are broken: multiplicity returns, but now as measured array rather than devouring accumulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding earth is pounded into flatness, and the focus root preserves both straight rows and smooth level ground. The two doubled constructions therefore describe successive phases of one spatial event: terrain is leveled, then occupied or articulated by ranks.

activation_trace.role: Supplies smooth, bare, level ground and receives direct activation from the preceding demolition.
Supplies the ranks that articulate the newly leveled field.
Supplies pounding and demolition until level, physically producing the focus field.
Supplies spreading and lowering, sharpening the transition from vertical terrain to horizontal array.
Supplies the earth as the lower counterpart to heaven and identifies the material surface transformed before the advent.

structural_cues: دكا دكا and صفا صفا are adjacent doubled accusative constructions.
The earth is the explicit patient of the first construction, while the angelic host occupies the second.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies demolition to levelness, earth, level-ground imagery, and ranks; I supply the phase arrow from leveled terrain to articulated host. A live alternative is that صف retains only its ordinary row sense and the lexical صفصف echo should remain background resonance.

changed_reading.before: The earth is destroyed, and then a separate angelic procession appears.
changed_reading.after: One geometry unfolds across both ayat: all elevation is erased into a bare field, and that field is then measured by rank after rank.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus gives ربك as the active subject of جاء; the next ayah gives Jahannam as what is brought in a passive construction. Repetition of the same root distributes agency asymmetrically: the sovereign advents, while the object of judgment is compelled into presentation.

activation_trace.role: Supplies active arrival or occurrence with the Lord as grammatical subject.
Keeps the bringing and presentation branch latent so the following passive can disambiguate its proper target.
Supplies sovereign agency and marks the active arriver as categorically unlike what is presented.
Supplies bringing or presenting something and fits the passive presentation of Jahannam.
Supplies compulsion as a collateral pressure, making the presented object unable to withhold itself.

structural_cues: 89:22 uses active جاء with ربك as subject; 89:23 uses passive جيء with بجهنم.
The repeated root occurs across the ayah boundary before human remembrance begins.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the active-passive contrast and arrival, presentation, and compulsion branches; I supply the arrow that the contrast encodes an agency hierarchy. A live alternative is that the two clauses are parallel scene-setting statements without a deliberate asymmetry.

changed_reading.before: The Lord and Jahannam both arrive as successive elements of the scene.
changed_reading.after: The syntax sharply separates sovereign advent from compelled presentation: the Lord comes as agent, while Jahannam is brought as an object under that agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the advent, memory is recovered only when the due moment has arrived, and the human wishes that something had been advanced for the life that truly benefits. The focus coming therefore closes the interval in which preparation could still be sent ahead.

activation_trace.role: Supplies arrival toward a time or action and marks the event that ends the preparatory interval.
Supplies recall after forgetting and locates recovered understanding after the focus advent.
Supplies reaching the due point and adds a latent timing pressure to the question of how remembrance can now help.
Supplies advancing ahead and defines the action that regret recognizes as no longer possible.
Supplies life as benefit and good, sharpening what the missed advance should have served.

structural_cues: Human remembrance and the wish to have sent ahead occur only after the two coming constructions.
The deictic يومئذ is repeated around the remembered failure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrival, recovered memory, due-time resonance, advancement, and beneficial life; I supply the arrow that the focus advent forecloses preparation. A live alternative is that regret follows judgment narratively without defining the temporal force of جاء.

changed_reading.before: The coming announces that judgment is present.
changed_reading.after: The coming is the deadline made event: once it occurs, knowledge can return but no useful act can still be advanced into the life for which it was needed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending reverses the focus motion: the Lord comes, then the tranquil self is told to return to its Lord and enter successively into servants and garden. The rows can therefore coexist as tribunal, threshold, and reception corridor, while lordly completion reaches its homecoming phase.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the outward advent whose completion opens the inverse movement of return.
Supplies staged nurture and completion, allowing the final return to complete rather than contradict the advent.
Supplies the aligned ranks that can frame a passage of reception as well as an enforcement perimeter.
Supplies the life-bearing self as the agent invited into the reverse movement.
Supplies settled calm and distinguishes receptive return from compelled presentation.
Supplies restoration to a former relation and provides the explicit inbound counterpart to the focus coming.
Reactivates nurture and completion at the destination of return.
Supplies mutual satisfaction and makes the return reciprocal rather than merely submissive relocation.
Supplies crossing into an interior and turns the post-advent route into an actual threshold.
Supplies devoted service and identifies the first interior as a community of obedient relation.
Supplies the tree-covered garden as the second and final interior reached through the opened route.

structural_cues: The ending gives a directed sequence: return to your Lord, enter among My servants, enter My garden.
The accepted self is calm and mutually satisfied, in direct contrast to the compelled presentation and binding sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward advent, explicit return, mutual acceptance, and two entries; I supply the arrow that the focus rows can frame a reception corridor and that lordly coming enables homecoming. A live alternative is that the rows remain exclusively judicial and the final address begins a separate scene.

changed_reading.before: The advent and rows form only a tribunal before punishment.
changed_reading.after: The same advent opens two opposed trajectories: forced presentation toward judgment and a calm, mutually accepted return through the ordered host into belonging and shelter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates collateral water branches under every focus root and crosses from court imagery into hydraulic process. It remains packet-anchored because جاء, رب, ملك, and صف each independently supply collection, abundant water, water-based control, or gathering at water, while the context supplies bursting, overflow, pouring, rain, and vegetation. Downstream prose should present it only as a convergent material resonance, never as a lexical translation of 89:22.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: All four focus roots have packet branches that can form a water system: collection basin, abundant water, control by water, and gathering at water.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a hollow where water collects and makes the advent point an exploratory convergence basin.
Supplies abundant gathered water and gives lordly presence the system's plenitude.
Supplies water as the resource by which a group controls its situation and provides the regulating element.
Supplies gathering together at water and turns the rows into regulated convergence.
Supplies a sudden abundant outburst and initiates the context's flow sequence.
Supplies overflowing water and sweeping force as the unregulated flow that requires control.
Supplies directed pouring and converts overflow into a governed downward movement.
Supplies rain descending as provision and keeps beneficial flow distinct from punitive overflow.
Supplies intertwined, surging vegetation as the productive terminus of regulated water.

changed_reading.before: The focus is exclusively a royal and military procession.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material resonance, the focus becomes the regulating convergence point where destructive overflow is gathered, controlled, and redirected toward ordered provision.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because عاد at 89:6 is a proper name, while the packet maps its root cue both to return and to a non-dominant count inventory. It remains structurally anchored through the focus arrival and doubled rows and gains support from the explicit return at 89:28. Downstream prose should call this a packet-licensed echo of recurrence and enumeration, not derive the historical name as a verb or replace its proper-name sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جاء can carry repeated coming, and صفا صفا visibly repeats an ordered unit.

activation_trace.role: Supplies repeated coming as a collateral branch and lets the final advent resonate as recurrence rather than first intervention.
Supplies the repeated ordered unit in which recurrence becomes visibly enumerable.
Supplies return after departure under the proper-name cue and makes prior judgment a possible recurrence pattern.
Uses the packet's non-dominant mapped inventory to supply counting and connect historical recurrence to the numbered focus ranks.
Supplies explicit return near the close and prevents recurrence from depending on the proper-name cue alone.

changed_reading.before: The final advent is wholly discontinuous from the historical judgments.
changed_reading.after: As a contained echo, the advent is the return of an already demonstrated pattern at total scale, now counted and displayed row by row.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the elevation image comes from the packet's non-dominant ر ب و mapping under the focus root ر ب ب, not from the surface form رب itself. It remains anchored through that explicit split mapping, the focus's level-ground branch, the immediately flattened earth, and the later image of calm lowering. Downstream prose should render it as a vertical resonance about false elevation and level presence, not as the lexical meaning of ربك.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split رب inventory places increase and raised ground beside the focus صف branch of level ground.

activation_trace.role: Supplies increase and elevation from the non-dominant mapped root and introduces the vertical pole of the resonance.
Supplies raised ground and gives the vertical pole a terrain image.
Supplies smooth level ground as the horizontal counter-pole within the focus.
Supplies lowering and spreading, removing created elevation immediately before the focus.
Supplies physical lowering as a collateral image of tranquility and extends leveling from terrain into posture.

changed_reading.before: The advent crowns a hierarchy above a flattened world.
changed_reading.after: As a contained vertical resonance, true presence appears only when claimed elevations are lowered: raised terrain gives way to a level field, and settled lowering replaces self-exaltation.

strongest_changes: The earlier actions of the same Lord revise coming from the start of agency into the public manifestation of agency already at work.
The adjacent دكا دكا and صفا صفا constructions turn demolition and array into successive phases: accumulated heaps and raised terrain are broken, then multiplicity is re-formed under measure.
The active جاء ربك followed by passive جيء بجهنم establishes an agency hierarchy between sovereign advent and compelled presentation.
The social sequence activates care, fosterage, and ownership branches so the advent audits possession by whether it nurtures, feeds, and protects.
The closing return and double entry preserve a non-punitive trajectory: the same ordered scene can be tribunal, threshold, and reception corridor.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained several coexisting mechanisms without collapse: sovereign court, completion of care, distributive sorting, counter-architecture, containment, dispossession, temporal deadline, and reciprocal homecoming. The packet also activated coherent but deliberately contained hydraulic, recurrence-count, and vertical-leveling resonances.
remaining_uncertainties: The level-ground sense under ص ف ف is strongly activated by 89:21 but remains form-distant from the ordinary row construction.
The ownership and mainstay branches under م ل ك enrich the literal angel branch, but their semantic weight should remain secondary to the surface form.
Rows may function simultaneously as display, containment perimeter, partition, witness body, and reception corridor; the verse does not force one spatial role.
The non-dominant mappings ر ب ب to ر ب و and ع و د to ع د د are packet-authorized but especially fragile and should stay explicitly exploratory.
Several causal arrows depend on reading packet order as mechanism rather than juxtaposition, especially dawn-to-unveiling and monument-to-counter-architecture.
